chunks: And from him, from Mu'awiya ibn Hakim, from Mu'ammar ibn Khallad, from Al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him saying: 'It is appropriate for a man, when he rises in the morning, to recite fifty verses after the concluding phrases (of the Fatiha and Surah).

key_terms.إِذَا أَصْبَحَ: When he rises in the morning
key_terms.التَّعْقِيبِ: The concluding phrases or supplications recited after the initial recitations in prayer

ai.seo_question: How many verses should be recited in the morning prayer after the initial surahs according to Imam Al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) prescribes reciting fifty verses of the Quran after the obligatory morning prayer (Fajr) as a recommended act of devotion, emphasizing the spiritual benefit of consistent Quranic engagement in the morning hours. This practice highlights the Shia emphasis on integrating Quranic recitation into daily rituals to strengthen one's connection with the Divine after the primary act of worship.
